_source: OnlyWorlds demo world 0000000000 (world 068e012b-52a9-79bf-8000-26bb67891425), fetched 2026-07-19; re-verified against live 2026-07-24
_bake_notes: legacy marker-based zone twin merged into the creature-referenced zone (markers retargeted, order from names)
imgur image_urls replaced by bundled webp via x_tour_media (offline tour); boot writes them as local media
pin renamed from 'Pin @ (237,305)'

link weave added (title issuer/holders, consul abilities/objects/institutions, creature species, collective members/zones, event participants) -- upstream demo carries no links; suggest Skeld adopt server-side

book 'Hyperion' + 'Chapter 1' narratives minted for the writing act (not upstream) -- chapter story is the sentence verbatim with ow:// chips; chip labels are deliberate display overrides so the sentence stays word-exact
atlas_aliases baked for the sentence surface forms -- keeps the chapter chips word-exact under label sync and feeds the @ picker
Rachmaninov birth_date (1873, Earth chronology) removed -- it stretched the chart axis to 0..1873 and crushed the dated events; the world clock runs 0..100

consul.objects gains Ebony Spaceship (balcony implied via parent_object, deliberately not listed); collective renamed Pack of Bellowing Saurians -> Saurian Pack (the word "bellowed" reveals after the collective does).
events re-dated to a SHARED year 7: the sentence has him playing WHILE the saurians surge, so two different dates contradicted the prose the tour is built on

title 'Consul of the Hegemony' given grant_date 3 and deliberately NO revoke_date: an open-ended title renders as a span running to the world’s now with a fade cap, which is the tour’s range/open-end lesson

Rachmaninov birth_date -320 and his Prelude start_date -318: placed in the Old Earth era for the deep-time beat. EDITORIAL -- the books never state the PC epoch, so no conversion from Earth’s calendar is asserted anywhere in copy; the depth is chosen for teaching, not for canon
world time_current REMOVED so the user sets the now themselves in the charts act; time_range_min widened to -400 to cover the Old Earth era

calendar construct 'Hegemony Standard' minted: two eras sharing the pivot at 0 (Old Earth counting down, PC counting up). Both terms are in-text; PC is never glossed because the novels never expand it

character 'Steinway' renamed to 'Mr. Steinway': the bare key collided with the 'Steinway' alias on object "The Consul’s Steinway", and autolink/bulk-link skip any key with 2+ candidates (prose-autolink.ts) -- the sentence’s Steinway could never link

Chapter 1 story baked with NO ow:// chips: the writing beat is hands-on, the user Tab-links the recognised words themselves and bulk-links the rest. The aliases above are what make every surface form recognisable

'Story of the old piano' given supertype 'Draft': without a writing-label supertype getTierForNarrative returns null and the narrative is INVISIBLE in the writing room. Not revealed during the tour; a curious user finds it after

the Consul alias list trimmed to ['Consul']: 'the Consul' never matched anything -- longest-first scanning consumes 'The Hegemony' at the sentence start, so the lowercase variant was dead weight cluttering the element’s field
world description CLEARED (Titus's call): the 'One sentence of a world...' line read as clutter on the home page during the tour; minimal for now

RE-SNAPSHOT from Titus's live rebuild (2026-07-23): the spatial layer is HIS -- map 'Unnamed planet' (his imgur image baked to unnamed-planet.webp, 1054x1492; the bundle stays offline, live keeps the URL), zone 'Swamps' (6 markers, named 'Swamps - Point N' here and live so tour refs resolve), his pin adopted and named. The old map/zone/9-markers/pin are deleted; the orphan live zone 'The Swamps' (7b9104fb, dangling since the map it pointed at never existed live) deleted live too

location renamed 'Unnamed Planet' (Titus, live): the unnamed-world resolution -- the opening scene is NOT on Hyperion (hyperion.txt L307); the planet below the balcony is unnamed in the book and now in the world
collective renamed 'Pack of Bellowing Saurians' (Titus, live)
Steinway parent_object = Ebony Spaceship, location cleared (Titus, live): objects nest like the balcony does

DATES RE-DERIVED from the source: title grant_date 1 + both events at 12 = the Consul's SOURCED eleven-year tenure (L327 + L3823, two witnesses); events share one date (Titus's ruling -- he plays WHILE they surge). Deep time via the L1130 epoch (AD 2732 = 589 P.C. -> P.C. 0 ~ AD 2143): Rachmaninov born AD 1873 -> -270, Prelude composed AD 1892 -> -251. time_range_min -300. The Earth<->PC conversion IS asserted now (one line in the book reconciles four calendars); the earlier no-conversion ruling was made before L1130 was found and Titus ordered the source update
Titus's live 'new book' / 'new page' narratives are test artifacts: left live, excluded from the bundle

Re-verify vs live (2026-07-24): map renamed 'Unnamed planet' -> 'Map of Unnamed planet' (Titus's live edit, adopted; TOUR_MAP_REF + specs follow). Everything else identical modulo the disk dialect (map_id/zone_id) and the documented editorial layer (link weave, reputation, no time_current -- live's time_range_current=0 deliberately NOT adopted, the set-now beat needs an unset clock). Titus's live test narratives ('new book'/'new page') stay excluded.

2026-09-28: pin + 6 swamps markers FLIPPED to the schema's bottom-left origin (y' = 1492 - y: pin 810->682; markers 689/731/802/838/810/757 -> 803/761/690/654/682/735). Atlas stored y top-down until then and Titus placed these in atlas on 07-23, so the bundle was y-down. The LIVE demo world (key 0000000000) still holds the old y-down numbers: a re-bake must flip them again, or the live world must be flipped first.
